column2: [intro]
At the park, I’m having fun on swings,
Making faces, I’m a true victory, it seems.
People stare, some think I’m quite insane,
But I’m thrilled, a star breaking the chain.
In public places, I’m full of glee,
I marvel at everything, so carefree.
I wander through the crowd like a lost child,
In public spaces, I’m enchanted and wild.
At the grocery store, I play the diva’s part,
Strutting down the aisles, a music lover’s art.
Security’s on my tail, employees confused,
But I don’t care, I’m an artist, so enthused.
In public places, I’m making a show,
Dancing, singing, with a vibrant glow.
Surprised looks and smiles in season,
In public spaces, I lead my revolution.
[ solo ]
In public places, I’m free to be me,
Spreading joy, setting spirits free.
So join me now, let’s dance and sway,
In public spaces, let’s be wild and play.
[outro]
